facts.fact: The digital economy ministry's account of its minister's speech of 13 November 2024 names, among the prerequisites for AI, the installation of fibre under a project to connect schools, health centres, mairies and households; it gives no count of mairies, no date and no financing, and does not say any mairie is yet connected.
